title: Change Function Declaration

solutions.title: Rename to say what it does, then drop the parameter the catalogue already carries
solutions.tradeoff: The lookup can only ever report on the season of the catalogue it was handed - a caller that wanted to ask about a different season now needs a different catalogue. That is honest, and it is a door this closes.

reviewFocus: Is the new name true for a function that throws? `findCourse` promises `undefined` on a miss and would be a fresh lie.
Was the `season` parameter removed only after confirming every call site already passed `catalogue.season`? Nothing else makes that step safe.
Were the callers migrated one at a time with a green suite between them, or fixed in a single edit across the file?
Does the thrown message still read exactly as before, including which catalogue's season it names? That string is the only observable proof the change preserved behaviour.
Did the signature change stop at the target function, or did it leak into the exported callers - whose signatures the tests freeze?
